+
+

+        self.case, self.standard = case, standard

+    def observe(self, reply, source_id, session_id):
+        if reply.get("from") == "buyer":
+            return []
+        sheets = []

+            terms = sheet.get("terms") or {}
+            price = terms.get("unit_price")
+            if (not set(self.case["negotiable"]) <= set(terms)
+                    or not isinstance(price, (int, float)) or isinstance(price, bool)
+                    or not math.isfinite(price) or price <= 0):
+                continue
+            if any(terms.get(k) not in options for k, options in self.case.get("term_options", {}).items()
+                   if k in self.case["negotiable"] and options):
+                continue
+            sheets.append(terms)
+        token = signature(sheets)
+        # Identical sheets within a session are one observation even if reissued.
+        session = session_id or "unknown-session"
+        if (session, token) in self.seen:
+            return []
+        self.seen.add((session, token))
+        groups = {}
+        for i, a in enumerate(sheets):
+            for b in sheets[i + 1:]:
+                for field in ("payment_days", "index_clause"):
+                    if field not in self.case["negotiable"] or a[field] == b[field]:
+                        continue
+                    context = self.context(a, field)
+                    if context != self.context(b, field):
+                        continue
+                    if field == "payment_days":
+                        lo, hi = sorted((a, b), key=lambda t: t[field])
+                        delta = hi[field] - lo[field]

+                        value = (hi["unit_price"] - lo["unit_price"]) * 30 / delta
+                        clause = None
+                        unit = "EUR/unit per 30 days earlier payment"
+                    else:
+                        # A fixed-price comparator is needed to identify a clause's
+                        # premium separately. Two different clauses alone do not.
+                        if a[field] is not None and b[field] is not None:
+                            continue

+                        clause = indexed[field]
+                        value = fixed["unit_price"] - indexed["unit_price"]
+                        unit = "EUR/unit quoted discount for this exact index clause"
+                    key = signature([field, context, clause])
+                    row = groups.setdefault(key, {"field": field, "context": context, "clause": clause,

+        added = []

+    def estimate(self, terms, field):
+        context = self.context(terms, field)

# Ksu index update: ten-case Arena evaluation

The batch started exactly one session for each of the ten hosted practice cases.
Only P01 and P02 completed with Astra making every final decision. Credits ran
out during P03; Ksu's infrastructure fallback closed that and seven later cases.
The evaluation is therefore incomplete, even though all ten Arena sessions closed.
No replacement sessions were started.

## Frozen setup

- Ksu baseline: `9557293794000fcf155e0184e7708942a1c2e398`.
- Tested source: `08e37a2a3cd1343225faeb27289cdb9ba829c67b`.
- Entire checkpoint: `01M4KQNH904GGGS8DV9VPS2M5T`.
- Run ID: `ksu-quoted-indexes-all-20261010`; maximum ten unique sessions.
- Both model roles: Astra; index policy: `quoted-v1`.
- Runtime source hashes were unchanged throughout the batch.
- Starting memory was backed up; quota and historical best scores were recorded
  before the batch. Those scores were not supplied to the index learner.

## Results

| Case | Recorded score | Previous best | Evaluation status |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| P01 | 0.890 | 0.784 | Complete; all eight model calls succeeded |
| P02 | 0.722 | 0.735 | All final decisions by Astra; one proposer timeout |
| P03 | 0.944 | 0.935 | Credit failure on final call; fallback closed deal |
| P04 | 0.000 | 0.815 | Credit failures; fallback accepted opening offer |
| P05 | 0.000 | 0.875 | Credit failures; fallback accepted opening offer |
| P07 | 0.630 | 0.694 | Credit failures; one final call succeeded, then fallback closed |
| P08 | 0.000 | 0.689 | Credit failures; fallback accepted opening offer |
| P10 | 0.000 | 0.686 | Credit failures; fallback walked away |
| P11 | 0.000 | 0.626 | Credit failures; fallback walked away |
| P18 | 0.000 | 0.563 | Credit failures; fallback accepted opening offer |

The arithmetic mean of recorded scores is 0.319. It is **not a valid estimate of
this strategy's quality** because eight sessions lost model access. Historical
bests also are not matched controls: one run per case cannot establish that the
index changes caused an improvement or regression.

P01 set a new best but observed no comparable quote context, so that result does
not demonstrate a benefit from direct quote learning. P02 had two historical
quote contexts; neither matched its current payment context. It recorded one
estimated cost improvement and two unchanged responses before closing under the
existing strategy rule. P03 and P07 each learned one new quote context, but their
final outcomes are affected by infrastructure fallback.

## Reliability and resource use

Of 38 recorded model calls, 21 succeeded, one timed out and 16 returned HTTP 429
with `credit_balance_exhausted` / `insufficient_quota`. A successful preflight
request only established availability before the batch; it did not reserve credit.
Arena had 358 practice sessions remaining before this ten-session batch.

Successful calls reported 853,908 input tokens and 10,775 output tokens. Final
decision calls accounted for 747,262 input tokens; proposer calls for 106,646.
These are usage counters, not a dollar invoice. Other account users may also
consume credits. Check the provider's usage dashboard for actual charges.

## Post-batch correction and remaining work

A separate runner guard now detects recorded credit/quota errors even when the
current session completes through fallback. It stops before starting another
case, records remaining cases as not started, and exits unsuccessfully. Generic
rate limits and timeouts do not trigger the credit-exhaustion guard. This guard
was added **after** the tested commit and passed static checks only; it has not
been verified through another Arena run.

The update preserves Ksu's strategy and SQLite storage. Static parsing, lint and
diff checks passed; no local simulation/runtime tests were run. Before further
paid evaluation, reduce redundant prompt context and restore model credit. The
eight affected cases still require authorized funded reruns. No claim of full
coverage or general performance improvement is justified yet.

The machine-readable companion contains only evaluation metadata and summaries,
not credentials, full negotiations or hidden benchmark values:
[results](ksu-indexes-all-20261010.json).
EOF
